summary: Security review passed for the LLM bridge autostart change. The new process manager is restricted to local loopback bridge URLs, starts Bun without shell interpolation, avoids secret logging, and preserves existing provider-secret handling in the bridge.
threat_model: Assets: provider API keys, active provider/model selection, local bridge config, AppForge runtime state, and localhost bridge/web ports.
Actors: local user running the source checkout, browser UI user on the same machine, external LLM provider endpoints, and a misconfigured or unavailable local bridge.
Entry points: /api/llm/* FastAPI routes, APPFORGE_LLM_BRIDGE_URL, APPFORGE_LLM_BRIDGE_AUTOSTART, APPFORGE_SKIP_LLM_BRIDGE, and the Bun llm_bridge process.
Trust boundaries: browser to FastAPI same-origin API, FastAPI to local Bun bridge HTTP, local process environment to child Bun process, and bridge to external provider APIs.

Abuse cases reviewed: command injection through bridge URL, auto-starting arbitrary remote services, leaking API keys in logs/errors, infinite startup polling, killing unrelated bridge processes, and masking real bridge HTTP validation errors.

checks.evidence: appforge tool run secret_scan returned passed true with no findings.
appforge tool run dependency_audit returned This tool requires allow_network=true; network audit was not run in this restricted environment.
appforge tool run generate_sbom wrote .appforge/reports/sbom.cdx.json with 0 lightweight components.
appforge/llm_bridge_process.py calls subprocess.Popen with argv ["bun", "run", "start"], cwd fixed to the bundled llm_bridge directory, and no shell=True.
_bridge_bind allows only http URLs with hostname 127.0.0.1, localhost, or ::1 before autostarting a process.
The new manager does not inspect API keys; web.py continues passing apiKey only to the existing llm_bridge client and does not add key logging.
ensure_running uses an RLock, one managed process reference, APPFORGE_BRIDGE_TIMEOUT polling, and shutdown only terminates the Popen it created.

secrets_scan: Passed: no likely committed credentials or private keys were found by appforge secret_scan.
dependency_audit: Not run: the AppForge dependency_audit tool requires allow_network=true. No network audit was performed in this environment; package build and SBOM generation still passed.
residual_risks: Live external provider calls depend on user-supplied API keys and provider-side security; this change did not perform credentialed provider calls.

The child Bun process inherits the process environment, matching existing bridge behavior so provider environment keys can work; operators should avoid launching with unnecessary secrets in the environment.
If llm_bridge dependencies are missing, the app returns guidance instead of auto-installing, avoiding implicit network work from a settings request.
Dependency vulnerability status remains unknown until a network-enabled audit is run.
